title: Pure F.A.
summary: Pure F.A. Synchro control build including the two U.A. crossovers that are always treated as F.A. cards (U.A. Hyper Stadium and U.A. Locker Room), paired with generic staples. Every F.A. monster has 0 base ATK, gains 300 ATK per Level, increases its Level whenever an F.A. Spell/Trap or effect activates, and unlocks a floodgate or bonus effect once it reaches Level 7 or higher.

summary.title: Starters
points: F.A. Auto Navigator searches any F.A. Field Spell on Normal or Special Summon, and can Special Summon itself from the hand or GY by reducing a high-Level F.A. monster's Level to original and setting its own Level to the difference.
U.A. Hyper Stadium (always treated as an F.A. card) searches any F.A. monster on activation and reveals a Field Spell in hand with 1000 LP to grant an extra Normal Summon of an F.A. monster.

Destroying any F.A. Field Spell—F.A. City Grand Prix, F.A. Circuit Grand Prix, or F.A. Off-Road Grand Prix—with F.A. Test Run or Ancient Fairy Dragon triggers its GY effect to search any F.A. card from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: F.A. Auto Navigator + F.A. Field Spell (or U.A. Hyper Stadium)
steps: Activate U.A. Hyper Stadium to search F.A. Auto Navigator (or Normal Summon Auto Navigator to search F.A. City Grand Prix).
Activate a second Field Spell (or destroy your active Field Spell with F.A. Test Run) to trigger the destroyed Field Spell's search for F.A. Hang On Mach or F.A. Dark Dragster.

Summon F.A. Hang On Mach; with an F.A. Field Spell raising its Level by 2 and Spell activations raising it further, use F.A. Auto Navigator in the GY to reduce Hang On Mach's Level back to 4, summoning Auto Navigator as a Level 3 Tuner.
Synchro Summon Level 7 F.A. Dawn Dragster (or Level 9 F.A. Motorhome Transport) and keep Hang On Mach at Level 7+ via F.A. City Grand Prix and F.A. Downforce.

summary.title: Level Modulation & Level 7 Threshold
summary.text: The three F.A. Grand Prix Field Spells boost the Levels of all F.A. monsters on the field by 2 (City Grand Prix during the Main and Battle Phases while granting targeting protection; Off-Road Grand Prix during the Main Phase; Circuit Grand Prix during the Battle Phase). Every time an F.A. Spell/Trap or effect is activated, each F.A. monster can increase its Level by 1, pushing Level 4 racers over the Level 7 threshold where their floodgates turn on.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: F.A. Dawn Dragster (Level 7 Synchro) inflicts piercing battle damage and reduces its Level by 2 as a Quick Effect to negate and destroy any Spell or Trap Card or effect.

F.A. Hang On Mach is unaffected by activated effects from opponent's monsters whose original Level/Rank is lower than its Level, and at Level 7+ banishes any card sent to the opponent's GY (a one-sided Macro Cosmos).

F.A. Whip Crosser forces the opponent to pay 300 LP to activate effects of lower-Level/Rank monsters and blocks them from discarding or sending cards from hand at Level 7+; F.A. Sonic Meister attacks twice at Level 7+; and F.A. Turbo Charger blocks battle responses at Level 7+.

F.A. Dark Dragster Special Summons itself when you control a Level 7+ F.A. monster and spends 3 Levels to destroy a card, F.A. Motorhome Transport becomes indestructible at Level 11+ and revives an F.A. at Level 13+, and F.A. Shining Star GT negates monster effects using Athlete Counters.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: F.A. Test Run changes an F.A. monster's battle position to destroy 1 card on the field (including your own Field Spell to search), and banishes itself from the GY to destroy 1 face-up card you control and Special Summon an F.A. monster from the Deck.

F.A. Downforce increases an F.A. monster's Level by 2 on the field and again by banishing itself from the GY; F.A. Pit Stop reduces a racer's Level by 2 to draw cards per Pit Stop in your GY and banishes itself to revive an F.A. monster.
U.A. Locker Room recovers an F.A. from the field or GY and shuffles cards from hand to draw, while F.A. Overheat and F.A. Dead Heat summon racers and activate Field Spells on the opponent's turn.

main: F.A. Auto Navigator
Tuner: searches an F.A. Field Spell; takes a racer's extra Levels as its own.
F.A. Hang On Mach
Racer: unaffected by smaller monsters; banishes what goes to their GY at Level 7.
F.A. Sonic Meister
Racer: survives smaller attackers; attacks twice at Level 7.
F.A. Whip Crosser
Racer: taxes small monsters' effects; stops hand costs at Level 7.
F.A. Turbo Charger
Level 6 racer: draws attacks and targeting; no responses in battle at Level 7.
F.A. Dark Dragster
Summons itself next to a Level 7 racer; spends Levels to destroy a card.
U.A. Hyper Stadium
Field Spell treated as F.A.: searches an F.A. monster; grants an extra Normal Summon.
F.A. City Grand Prix
Field Spell: +2 Levels in Main and Battle Phase; stops targeting; searches when destroyed.
F.A. Circuit Grand Prix
Field Spell: +2 Levels in battle; draws on kills; searches when destroyed.
F.A. Off-Road Grand Prix
Field Spell: +2 Levels in the Main Phase; searches when destroyed.
F.A. Test Run
Destroys a card, often your own Field Spell; from the GY, trades your card for a racer from the Deck.
F.A. Downforce
Raises a racer by 2 Levels, twice per copy.
F.A. Pit Stop
Lowers a racer to draw; revives one from the GY.
U.A. Locker Room
Quick-Play treated as F.A.: recovers a racer; shuffles racers back to draw.
F.A. Overheat
Summons a racer from the hand when only they have monsters; reactivates a Field Spell.
F.A. Dead Heat
Summons a racer from the Deck on a direct attack.
